oneLine: Embassy sells its entire Juhu residential tower to Dinesh Thakkar for Rs 711 cr.

sources.title: Embassy sells entire Juhu residential tower to Dinesh Thakkar for ₹711 cr

synopsis: Bengaluru-based real estate company Embassy Developments has signed a memorandum of understanding to sell an entire residential tower at its ultra-luxury project Embassy Terazza in Mumbai's Juhu to Dinesh Thakkar, chairman and managing director of Angel One. The transaction is valued at 711 crore rupees. The property is a ground-plus-seven-storey tower spanning 63,000 square feet of carpet area within the Embassy Terazza development, which is being built on a two-acre site with an estimated gross development value exceeding 3,000 crore rupees. Embassy Developments is developing the project under a development management model. Dinesh Thakkar has named the new residence Angelus.
